subject: Release cadence & gating Qs — readiness checkpoints and docs backlog
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Product Launch <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, GTM Ops <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Release cadence proposal + gating checklist (first pass)

Team —

I want to get alignment on a proposed cadence for the upcoming release and a minimal set of gating checkpoints so we can sign-off quickly for the Acme pilot. High-level ask: can we aim for a staged rollout with 2 waves (internal + pilot wave) and a final ramp the week after?

Proposed gating checklist (minimum):
- Code freeze for runtime changes (T-5 days)
- Staging smoke tests: perf, KV cache correctness, streaming stability
- Security/compliance: audit log export verified for pilot account
- Enablement: customer-facing playbook + one internal training slot
- SLA exceptions doc reviewed and deputy approvals set

I've attached an initial staging cut matrix and a very rough enablement outline. Please reply with owners and any must-have gates we can't skip.

[Attachment: staging_cut_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 65KB)]
[Attachment: enablement_plan_v1.pdf (PDF, 480KB)]

Thanks,
Markus
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Release cadence proposal + gating checklist (first pass)

Thanks Markus — good starting point. A few clarifications from product: 

1) Staging smoke tests: can we add a focused prompt regression set (25 prompts) to validate quality after quantization changes? I can own curating that with Applied ML.
2) Audit log export: for Acme we need S3 delivery + hashed PII scrubbed. Security needs to confirm the scrub pipeline has been tested end-to-end.
3) Training slot: prefer two internal sessions (one eng deep-dive, one customer ops walkthrough).

I'll take the prompt set and coordinate with Applied ML. For the scrubbed audit export I will loop in Security separately but need an expected completion date to include in the gating sign-off.

-Neha
Sr PM, Launch Readiness

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T13:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Release cadence proposal + gating checklist (first pass)

Agree with Neha. Two quick notes from GTM/enablement side: 
- SLA exceptions: we have an open ask from Finance to capture any non-standard credit / SLA adjustment requests up front. I sketched a simple exceptions log (attached) — we'll need clear approval owners (Legal, Finance, Product) so CS can move quickly during pilot incidents.
- Customer playbook: Laura, can you confirm the owner and whether the playbook will be a short-runbook or a full-runbook? Short is fine for pilot but we need at least the runbook with 3 escalation tiers.

[Attachment: sla_exceptions_log.csv (CSV, 12KB)]

—Ben
Head of GTM Operations

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T09:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Release cadence proposal + gating checklist (first pass)

All —

I can own the pilot playbook. Plan: produce a short runbook (2–3 pages) focused on the pilot flows, plus a single-slide escalation map. Deliverables and owners: 
- Short runbook (Laura) — draft by 2026-12-03
- Internal training deck (Laura + Neha) — 2026-12-04
- One-hour eng deep-dive (Vivek to present) — schedule for 2026-12-06

On the audit export scrub: Neha, please share the expected completion date; if Security needs a formal test report we should slot that before T-1.

I'll upload the draft runbook to the Drive link and flag questions inline.

Laura Bennett
Sr Manager, Customer Enablement
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: enablement_plan_v1.pdf (PDF, 480KB)]

From: Sara Jones <sara.jones@acmecorp.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Release cadence proposal + gating checklist (first pass)

Hi all —

Thanks for pulling this together. A couple quick items from Acme's side: 
- We prefer the pilot wave to start on 2026-12-10 instead of 12-08 to align with our internal security window. Is a two-day shift workable?
- We need the short runbook and the escalation slide at least 48 hours before our kickoff. Can you confirm the 12-03 draft delivery?
- On the audit export scrub: our security team requires a sample export for review (masked). Can you indicate whether you can provide that by 12-06?

If the dates above are tight, let's move the internal training earlier so we can still meet their readiness.

Best,
Sara Jones
Head of Product, Acme Corp
